definitions.local_day: [local midnight, next local midnight) in the requested timezone; records are assigned by their start time. Record source_timezone is provenance only.
definitions.sample_mean: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the sample values recorded on the local day, rounded half-even to 6 decimals. Not a time-weighted all-day average.
definitions.sample_min_max: Smallest and largest sample value recorded on the local day.
definitions.interval_total_sum: Sum of interval_total values whose interval starts on the local day. Values are taken as reported; durations are never derived from timestamps.
definitions.daily_total: Vendor daily total whose interval equals the local day exactly. Never added to interval_total_sum.
definitions.daily_summary: Vendor daily summary value whose interval equals the local day exactly.
definitions.null: No supported data for that statistic on that day. Missing data is never zero.
definitions.warning:interval_crosses_day_boundary: An interval ends on a later local day. It is assigned to its start day without splitting or proportional allocation.
definitions.warning:overlapping_intervals: An interval_total record overlaps another record of the same provider, including records on adjacent days or starting outside the window. The start day of every record involved gets interval_total_sum null, because overlapping intervals cannot be deduplicated reliably.
definitions.warning:zero_length_interval: An interval_total record with started_at equal to ended_at has no duration, so its total cannot be placed or checked for overlap. It is counted in unsupported_count and excluded from interval_total_sum.
definitions.warning:unaligned_daily_record: A daily_total or daily_summary interval does not equal the local day exactly; it is counted in unaligned_count and otherwise ignored.
definitions.warning:multiple_daily_records: Several aligned daily records exist for one provider and day (for example several devices); no value is chosen.
definitions.warning:mixed_total_kinds: Both daily_total and interval_total exist for the same provider and day; they are reported separately and never combined.
definitions.warning:unsupported_aggregation: Records whose aggregation is not supported for this metric class are counted in unsupported_count and excluded from statistics.
definitions.warning:no_records_in_window: The user has no records for this metric in the window. This says nothing about activity, device wear or authorization.
definitions.provider: Acquisition channel, not a single device. Grouping by provider does not deduplicate several devices reporting through one channel.
definitions.mean_of_daily_sample_means: Unweighted mean of sample_mean over valid days (days with at least one sample). Every day weighs the same; this is not the pooled mean of all samples, which would weigh densely sampled days more, and not a time-weighted average.
definitions.mean_of_daily_totals: Unweighted mean of one total per valid day. A day's total is its unique, day-aligned daily_total; only days with no daily_total record at all fall back to interval_total_sum. A zero total is a valid value.
definitions.valid_day: A day that contributes a value. Validity means a usable value exists, not that the device covered the whole day.
definitions.days_invalid: Days with records but no usable value: conflicting or unaligned daily totals, overlapping intervals, or only unsupported records.
definitions.days_from_interval_total: Days whose total came from interval_total_sum. Interval sums cover only the recorded intervals and do not guarantee full-day coverage.
definitions.days_with_unused_daily_summary: Point-metric days that have a vendor daily_summary but no samples. daily_summary does not enter the window mean; such days are not valid days, but they are not days without data either.
definitions.difference: current.value minus baseline.value, null when either window value is null. No percentage is reported.
definitions.warning:sparse_window: Fewer than half of the days in the window are valid.
definitions.warning:insufficient_data: A window has no valid day, so its value and the difference are null.
definitions.warning:provider_missing_in_window: The provider has records in only one of the two windows; the other side is null.
definitions.warning:interval_totals_used: At least one day's total is an interval sum, which does not guarantee full-day coverage.
definitions.warning:mixed_bases_within_window: Some days use daily_total and others interval_total_sum inside one window.
definitions.warning:basis_differs_between_windows: The two windows do not use the same set of total bases, so part of the difference may reflect how data was recorded.
definitions.warning:daily_summary_not_used: Vendor daily_summary records exist but are not part of the window mean.
